Data problems found and fixed:
1. Price stored as text: two values ("$300.00" on row 23, "$50.00" on row 39) had dollar signs. Converted the Price column to numeric — no values were lost.
2. Impossible quantity: row 34 had Quantity = -7 (rules say quantity must be a positive whole number), producing a negative Revenue of -1260. That row was excluded from the analysis.

Checks that passed: Category labels all match the allowed set with no variants; no duplicate rows; Revenue = Quantity × Price holds on every row; no missing values in Price or Category.

Caveats: Region has some messy variants ("Wst", "Eats", extra spaces) and one missing value, but Region isn't used in this question so it was left untouched.
